_comment: The IF tested CARD_IN_ZONE(OPPONENT_GRAVEYARD, card_type=RED) -- 'RED' is a colour, not a card type, and the banished card is what the text asks about. CONDITIONAL did not read 'condition' either, so the repeat happened every time regardless. Now gated on the colour of the card that was banished. Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
